gates.title: Acquisition qualification
gates.required_evidence: Scope mux settling and ADC start, actual uniform sample cadence, missed-slot counters, alias response and cross-talk.
gates.evidence_partial_note: Host-tested cycle-level model of the real acq_engine.c/scope_core.c passes (uniform slots, ring wrap/overrun, missed-slot accounting, channel-order invariance). Target UF2 builds clean. No bench-measured rate, settle, jitter, alias or cross-talk. Known unreconciled figure: firmware/ACQUISITION.md's implemented budget gives a 75us CH1->CH10 skew (9 slots x 8.333us); the generated architecture narrative (design/narrative-pages.json -> doc/.../architecture/acquisition.mdx) and reports/analog-analysis.json still carry a 72us figure from an earlier 8us-slot sketch that predates the #12 engine. ACQUISITION.md already states this discrepancy explicitly; reconciling the narrative source and analyze.py's hardcoded value is left open (see LOCAL-HANDOFF.md) because it is not a one-line fix -- the surrounding narrative paragraph frames the schedule as an unimplemented target, which is no longer accurate now that #12 shipped the engine.

gates.title: Firmware/display integration
gates.required_evidence: Build with actual Pico SDK; integrate exact vendor bridge driver; verify ten panes, time/range, controls, HOLD and LINK.
gates.evidence_partial_note: Clean-room Waveshare LCD backend; scope10_acq+lcd builds with SCOPE_ENABLE_LCD=1 against the real Pico SDK (0 warnings). A few vendor panel-tuning numbers (gamma/VCOM/frame-rate/scan/inversion) are used; LCD_VENDOR_PANEL_TUNING=0 excludes them (user decision, LOCAL-HANDOFF.md). SPI clocked conservatively at 15 MHz. No display was flashed or observed; G01's backlight-default decision must be resolved before enabling SCOPE_ENABLE_LCD locally.

gates.title: Power and USB budget
gates.required_evidence: Measure display backlight/inrush + Pico + analog rail; satisfy USB source contract and power sequencing.
gates.evidence_partial_note: Desk arithmetic only. design/power-contract.json now holds the explicit supported-source contract (>=500 mA at 5 V from attach, not established by enumeration or VBUS presence). No power gate ties +5V_FUSED to USB enumeration state, so the display/analog load path is unconditioned on the host granting any configured allowance (vs_unconfigured_limit: fail_or_unknown). The declared USB descriptor value is 250 mA (the unmodified Pico SDK 2.1.1 default; see power-contract.json's override_investigation for why a project override is not implemented), so the 420 mA planning allowance now correctly reports vs_declared_limit: fail rather than a masked pass against a fixed constant. F1 carries only the display+analog branch (340 mA); its 1.5x-derated target (510 mA) sits 10 mA above the selected 1206L050YR candidate's 500 mA nominal hold rating, with no manufacturer temperature-derating curve retained -- a tension, not a measured fault (see f1_branch_sizing in reports/power-budget.json). Backlight current and module-side VBUS bulk capacitance are unknown. Bench measurement of every supported power state (power-contract.json's power_states) is a local gate.
